name: blender_context
description: Compact read of the attached Blender scene: revision, scene settings, collections, markers, a page of objects (name, type, parent, collections, location, rotation with its mode, scale). ref = one object in detail (world bounds; pose bones with head, world direction, rotation); include parts lists a mesh's loose parts (vertices, world box, material, dominant vertex group), region keeps those meeting a world box. Call first; pass revision to blender_apply. quarantined: changes wait; quarantine.may_have_changed says what to check.

include.description: bounds and bones for every listed object; parts with ref: the mesh's loose parts, largest first.

release_quarantine.description: After a quarantine (a failed change not proven undone): the revision of the read that showed it, once you checked what may have changed; lifts it.

region.description: With include parts: {min: [x, y, z], max: [x, y, z]} in world space; the parts whose box meets it.
